definitions.gloss: pending issue; unresolved matter; outstanding concern
definitions.explanation: A problem or issue that has remained unresolved over time and requires attention. Often used in formal, political, and business contexts for matters that have been put off or are proving difficult to settle.

examples.japanese: {懸案|けんあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The long-standing issue was finally resolved.

examples.japanese: {両国間|りょうこくかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懸案|けんあん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Discussions were held on pending issues between the two countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懸案|けんあん}だった⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拡張工事|かくちょうこうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The road expansion project, a long-standing concern, has finally begun.

notes: Often used as a modifier: {懸案|けんあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (pending issue), ⟦{懸案事項|けんあんじこう}→懸案事項：26252_kenanjikou⟧ (outstanding matter). Commonly modified by ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (long-standing) or ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (biggest). Frequently appears in news reports about diplomacy, politics, and organizational management. More formal than ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧ (task/challenge), with a stronger nuance of something that has been left unresolved.
